journey.title: Recover from a backdrop the headline cannot survive
journey.purpose: The most common path, and the one the product exists for. Most ambient imagery fails a worst-pixel contrast test on first render — that is why the gate is worth building. This journey exercises the refusal and the route forward, so that 'refused' is never where the operator stops.

steps.intent: See that two of four candidates fail, each stating its measured ratio, its threshold, and the region measured — not a bare red mark.
Confirm the failure is real by seeing the headline sitting on the image, rather than trusting a number about a region that looks fine empty.
Select the strongest candidate anyway and read the amendments offered: adjust the overlay region, change placement, or re-roll the seed (LEG-006).
Accept the computed minimum scrim and see the before-and-after with the recomputed verdict, rather than a silently darkened image.

Persist the scrim as an amendment to the style so the next render of this style starts from a passing configuration, and observe that the style forks rather than mutating because a released backdrop already references it.
Release the amended candidate and confirm the verdict recorded against it is the passing one, with the amendment visible in its provenance.
